discussions.prompt:
4:3 catalog sheet on a flat dark charcoal gray field. Exactly two rows and four columns of equal white rounded cards with even gaps. One single item centered in each card, the whole object inside the card with a clear margin. No text, no numbers, no letters, no logos, no watermark. shop_ladder 同族形变. Family hue is magenta dewberry, leaf green, and cream jam. Each tier evolve_to a new silhouette. merge_why is a real form change, not a decoration swap. Gossip Harbor cabinet finish only: glossy chubby cartoon 3D, no hard ink outlines, warm saturated color, soft gradient light, clean specular highlights, thick toy volume. Not a photograph, not dull old plastic, not flat vector. The reference image locks item gloss only. Do not copy its beach, sand, palm, lobster, seafood platter, pointing hand, game board, HUD, coins, or the word Merge. Ignore any garden, animal, matte-satin, or empty-black-background habit.

Size is the first rule. Bounding-box height inside each card, left to right then top to bottom, about 48 percent, 55 percent, 61 percent, 67 percent, 72 percent, 77 percent, 82 percent, 86 percent. Every neighbor is obviously larger. The bottom-right feast is the largest object on the sheet and still inside its card.

Top row: one round magenta dewberry with a tiny green calyx, smallest complete fruit, no stick. Then two dewberries on one short wooden skewer, a horizontal bar, clearly bigger. Then a green leaf-boat cup holding dewberries, the leaf rim is the outline, the skewer is gone, bigger again. Then a narrow-neck small-mouth jam bottle of thick toy glass filled with cream-magenta jam, vertical, no ribbon, bigger again.
